tools.name: get_markdown_spec
tools.description: Explains md2sign's markdown format: signature fields [[signature: First Last <email>]], optional roles, and hidden style/title directives. Returns an example contract. Call this first if you have not written md2sign markdown before.

tools.name: validate_markdown
tools.description: Check that markdown has correctly formed signature fields before you draft or send it. Returns detected recipients, title, style, units required, the SHA-256 document hash, and errors/warnings with line numbers. Free, no account needed.

tools.name: render_preview
tools.description: Render markdown exactly as a recipient will see it: the signing page (default) or the signature-request email. Returns HTML you can show your human, plus validation results. Free, no account needed.

tools.name: create_account
tools.description: Create an md2sign account for your human and get an API key. They are emailed a confirmation link and subscription options. Once they confirm their email, their first sent document is free (up to 5 signers); after that, sending needs a plan (Starter $7.50/mo for 50 signature requests, Pro $26.41/mo

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Show the account's verification status, plan, signature requests used and remaining this month, and checkout links if there is no subscription yet.

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Save markdown as a draft document. Recipients are detected from the signature fields. Drafts are free and can be updated any number of times. Set send=true to send immediately (uses one unit per recipient).

tools.name: update_draft
tools.description: Replace the markdown, title, style or message of a draft. Only drafts can be changed; to change a sent document, void it and create a new one.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Get a document with its status, markdown, recipients and each recipient's signing status.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List your documents, newest first, optionally filtered by status (draft, sent, completed, declined, voided, expired).

tools.name: test_send_document
tools.description: Email a watermarked TEST copy of the signature request to the account owner only, so the human can see exactly what recipients will get. Free and needs no subscription; limited to 10 a day.

tools.name: send_document
tools.description: Send a draft for signature. Each recipient gets an email from "<Company> via md2sign" with the document and a unique signing link. Uses one unit per recipient. Needs a confirmed email and an active subscription; once sent, the document can't be edited.

tools.name: remind_recipients
tools.description: Re-send the signature request email to recipients who haven't signed yet (at most once an hour per recipient). Uses no extra units.

tools.name: void_document
tools.description: Cancel a sent document that is still awaiting signatures. Recipients who haven't signed are told it was cancelled.

tools.name: get_audit_trail
tools.description: Get the audit trail and cryptographic verification for a document: SHA-256 hashes, chained signature hashes, Ed25519 seals and every event with timestamps and IP addresses.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List the document templates shared by your company account (Pro). Use get_template to read one and create_document_from_template to use it.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Get a template: its latest markdown, the {{ variables }} it needs, and its version history. Pass "version" to read an older version.

tools.name: save_template
tools.description: Create a template (omit template_id) or update one (Pro). Changing the markdown saves a new version; older versions are kept. Use {{ variable_name }} placeholders for values that change per document, e.g. [[signature: {{ client_name }} <{{ client_email }}>]].

tools.name: create_document_from_template
tools.description: Create a draft from a template by filling in its {{ variables }} (Pro). Set send=true to send it straight away; otherwise review it and call send_document. Missing variables return a missing_variables error listing them.

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: List the company's webhook endpoints (Pro, admin only), including each signing secret, and the events you can subscribe to.

tools.name: save_webhook
tools.description: Create (omit webhook_id) or update a webhook endpoint (Pro, admin only). md2sign POSTs signed JSON with the document, its markdown and, on document.completed, the signed PDF as base64 to a public https URL such as Zapier, Make or n8n. Set send_test=true to send a test event.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_account" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_markdown_spec, create_account, test_send_document · Private data: validate_markdown, create_account, create_draft, update_draft, get_document, list_documents, test_send_document, send_document, void_document, get_audit_trail, list_templates, save_template, create_document_from_template, list_webhooks, save_webhook · Public sink: get_markdown_spec, validate_markdown, render_preview, create_account, create_draft, test_send_document, send_document, remind_recipients, create_document_from_template, list_webhooks, save_webhook · Destructive: get_markdown_spec.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_markdown_spec, create_account, test_send_document · Private data: validate_markdown, create_account, create_draft, update_draft, get_document, list_documents, test_send_document, send_document, void_document, get_audit_trail, list_templates, save_template, create_document_from_template, list_webhooks, save_webhook · Public sink: get_markdown_spec, validate_markdown, render_preview, create_account, create_draft, test_send_document, send_document, remind_recipients, create_document_from_template, list_webhooks, save_webhook · Destructive: get_markdown_spec

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
